Name: Giant Omelet
Author: spacechase0
Description:
A giant omelet has been spotted in the desert! Stop by to get a bit for free. Don't try to get more than one per person, though.

(You get 1-3 omelets of a random quality.)

[b][size=5]Install[/size][/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348]SpaceCore[/url]..
[*]Unzip the mod folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]

[b][size=5]Compatibility[/size][/b]
Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.5.5+ on Linux/macOS/Windows, both single-player and multiplayer.
